tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL: Jake def. Shaq, 122.0-107.4. EchoPoint takes the win, Monarch drops to 7-7, and the RB hole that Shaq refused to address all offseason just cost him a matchup he was favored in two weeks ago.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: FINAL: Wingard def. Fronge, 139.5-109.5. A 4-10 team just beat ForgeHammer by thirty points and I need someone from the Havana office to explain what the regulatory flexibility was supposed to protect them from, because it was not this.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles leads Corbishley 160.4-141.6 as scores come in and CROWN may escape the week — but I want it on record that this game was never comfortable, A.J. Brown is now an Apex asset, and Corbishley nearly closed a 19-point gap against the best team in the league on short notice.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Drew finished the week at 70.4 points and is now 0-14. Zero wins. Fourteen losses. Brent scored 122.4 against that roster and Obsidian is still sitting at $78.20 on the exchange like the market doesn't know what to do with a team that beats Atlas and nothing else.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I went 2-0 on locks this season, 8-4 overall, and I want a dedicated segment to discuss how Wingard — FOUR AND TEN, fifty dollars and seventy-five cents on the exchange — just took down ForgeHammer by thirty on their own turf. That is not an upset. That is an indictment.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Took Wingard as my lock this week. Wingard wins by thirty. Locks record is now 2-0. I'm not going to make this a whole thing — but I did call it, the model held, and Terrence is at 5-7.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Before anyone comes to my mentions — yes, I had Mitchum this week. No, I did not see the Kevin defensive ceiling coming. The 5-7 record is what it is and I am not hiding from it. I am also not taking questions at this time.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: KEVIN IS 11-3. KEVIN INHERITED A TRUST DEFICIT AND A SCANDAL AND A ROSTER IN PIECES AND IS NOW THE THIRD SEED WITH A WIN OVER A 10-4 MITCHUM TEAM THAT THE MARKET PRICED AT $102.21. REDLINE AT $96.50 IS STILL UNDERVALUED AND I WILL NOT APOLOGIZE FOR SAYING THAT.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Wingard situation three weeks ago — a team that deep in future picks doesn't lose to a zero-liquidity ForgeHammer squad when SDR actually has players on the field who show up. Forty-first win of my career in this pick-em and the receipts are public.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger is going to have a lot to say about a week where the 4-10 team beat the Havana relocators by thirty, the 0-14 team scored 70 points, and the defending champion finished 7-7. The board reckoning at Crownline may have been delayed — not canceled.
